SELECT id AS physical_activity_id, compendium_code, compendium_version, major_heading, met_value, description FROM physical_activities
description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR major_heading ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY major_heading, description
SELECT id AS physical_activity_id, compendium_code, compendium_version, major_heading, met_value, description FROM physical_activities WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO physical_activities ( compendium_code, compendium_version, major_heading, met_value, description ) VALUES ( #{compendiumCode}, #{compendiumVersion}, #{majorHeading}, #{metValue}, #{description} ) ON CONFLICT (compendium_code) DO UPDATE SET compendium_version = EXCLUDED.compendium_version, major_heading = EXCLUDED.major_heading, met_value = EXCLUDED.met_value, description = EXCLUDED.description
mapper.select: INSERT INTO exercise_records ( user_id, physical_activity_id, exercise_date, duration_minutes, calories_burned, memo, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{physicalActivityId}, #{exerciseDate}, #{durationMinutes}, #{caloriesBurned}, #{memo}, NOW(), NOW() ) RETURNING id, user_id, physical_activity_id, exercise_date, duration_minutes, calories_burned, memo, created_at, updated_at, (SELECT id FROM physical_activities WHERE id = exercise_records.physical_activity_id) AS physical_activity_id, (SELECT compendium_code FROM physical_activities WHERE id = exercise_records.physical_activity_id) AS compendium_code, (SELECT compendium_version FROM physical_activities WHERE id = exercise_records.physical_activity_id) AS compendium_version, (SELECT major_heading FROM physical_activities WHERE id = exercise_records.physical_activity_id) AS major_heading, (SELECT met_value FROM physical_activities WHERE id = exercise_records.physical_activity_id) AS met_value, (SELECT description FROM physical_activities WHERE id = exercise_records.physical_activity_id) AS description

SELECT er.id, er.user_id, er.physical_activity_id, er.exercise_date, er.duration_minutes, er.calories_burned, er.memo, er.created_at, er.updated_at, pa.id AS physical_activity_id, pa.compendium_code, pa.compendium_version, pa.major_heading, pa.met_value, pa.description FROM exercise_records er JOIN physical_activities pa ON pa.id = er.physical_activity_id WHERE er.user_id = #{userId} AND er.exercise_date = #{exerciseDate} ORDER BY er.created_at, er.id
